privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: OpenHelix AI ('we', 'us', 'our') is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, why we collect it, and how we use it.

collect.title: Information We Collect
collect.body: We collect information you provide (name, email, company details), usage data (pages visited, features used), and technical data (IP address, browser type) to operate and improve our service.

use.title: How We Use Your Information
use.body: We use your data to provide the OpenHelix AI service, communicate with you about your account, improve our platform, and send service-related notifications.

share.title: Data Sharing
share.body: We do not sell your personal data. We may share data with trusted service providers who help us operate the platform (e.g., cloud hosting, payment processing) under strict data processing agreements.

security.title: Data Security
security.body: We use industry-standard encryption and security practices. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. Contact us at hello@synapseforge.ai to exercise these rights.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy questions, contact us at hello@synapseforge.ai.

service.title: Use of Service

account.title: Account Responsibility

payment.title: Payment

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What if my agent gives a wrong answer?
faq.a1: You control the system prompt and knowledge base. The agent only answers based on what you provide. You can review all conversations in the manager dashboard and tune the agent anytime.
faq.a2: Most businesses are live in under 10 minutes. Our onboarding wizard walks you through every step — no developers needed.
faq.q3: Do I need a ChatGPT or OpenAI account?
faq.a3: You can start with 20 free sandbox messages using our platform key. After that, you connect your own OpenAI, Anthropic, or OpenRouter key — costs typically €1–5/month for a small business.
faq.q4: Which channels does it work on?
faq.a4: Currently Telegram and WhatsApp (via Twilio). Web chat embed is also available. More channels coming soon.
faq.a5: Yes, completely. No contracts, no commitments. You can delete your agent and account at any time.
faq.a6: Yes. Conversations are stored encrypted in your account only. We never use your data to train models or share it with third parties.
